verdict.rationale: Gladia is an audio transcription API, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. A probe confirms an official MCP server documented at docs.gladia.io/chapters/how-to-use-gladia/mcp.md, alongside its official CLI and llms.txt for agents. The pack only confirms the page exists, though, and says nothing about what it contains. missing for 10: details of exposed tools/capabilities, setup and client-connection instructions, transport/auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent
